translations.web: You shall observe to do therefore as Yahweh your God has commanded you. You shall not turn away to the right hand or to the left.
translations.bsb: So be careful to do as the LORD your God has commanded you; you are not to turn aside to the right or to the left.
translations.kjv: Ye shall observe to do therefore as the LORD your God hath commanded you: ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.
translations.asv: Ye shall observe to do therefore as Jehovah your God hath commanded you: ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.
